SPY.title: Have $100,000? Here Are 7 Ways to Grow That Money Into $1 Million for Retirement Savings
SPY.description: The article provides seven strategies to grow a $100,000 retirement savings into $1 million, including living below your means, boosting income, building an emergency fund, investing in stocks and dividend-paying stocks, and utilizing tax-advantaged retirement accounts.
SPY.author: The Motley Fool

SPY.title: Here's How Much a $25,000 Investment in the S&P 500 at the Start of 2025 Could Grow to Be Worth in 25 Years
SPY.description: The article discusses the potential growth of a $25,000 investment in the S&P 500 index over a 25-year period, noting that while the index has hit record highs, investors should expect lower-than-normal returns in the future. However, investing in the S&P 500 through an ETF can still be a good long-term strategy.
SPY.author: David Jagielski
